teams.name: Apex Racing
teams.archetype: The benchmark — strong everywhere, peerless aero
teams.history: Built its reputation on aerodynamics the rest of the grid spent a decade trying to reverse-engineer; the benchmark car for three straight seasons.

teams.name: Meridian GP
teams.archetype: Close challenger — best engine on the grid
teams.history: The engine department has always been the crown jewel — a power unit good enough to paper over whatever the chassis side gets wrong.

teams.name: Vortex Motors
teams.archetype: Aero specialist — flies in S2, weak on straights
teams.history: A wind-tunnel-obsessed operation that will sacrifice top speed for cornering grip every single time, for better and worse.

teams.name: Kestrel Sport
teams.archetype: Power team — rockets in S1, struggles in corners
teams.history: Built its identity around raw horsepower after a near-collapse a decade ago; still chasing the handling package to match it.

teams.name: Solstice Racing
teams.archetype: Solid midfield — fastest pit crew on the grid
teams.history: Runs the tightest pit crew on the grid by design — the team's philosophy is that races are won and lost in 2.4 seconds, not 90 minutes.

teams.name: Delta Dynamics
teams.archetype: Balanced midfield — no weakness, no standout
teams.history: The definition of a solid midfield operation — no obvious weakness, no obvious strength, and a development rate that quietly keeps closing the gap.

teams.name: Halcyon F1
teams.archetype: Great handling, fragile — mechanical grip but unreliable
teams.history: A small, ambitious team whose cars are a joy to drive and a nightmare to keep running — mechanical grip nobody else has, reliability nobody else would accept.

teams.name: Nimbus Grand Prix
teams.archetype: Lower midfield — decent crew keeps them in the fight
teams.history: Punches above its budget through pit-lane execution — a lower-midfield team that treats every strategy call like it's fighting for a podium.

teams.name: Terra Motorsport
teams.archetype: Backmarker on the rise — high development potential
teams.history: The fastest-developing team on the grid, climbing the order year over year on a shoestring budget and a point to prove.

teams.name: Zenith Racing
teams.archetype: Tail of the field — slow but bulletproof reliability
teams.history: Built on bulletproof reliability rather than pace — the team that finishes races other teams don't, even from the back of the field.
